text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

All papers lead with Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad saying national steelmaker Perwaja Steel is being privatised to Maju Holdings with 51 percent equity, with Lion Group seen taking a 30 percent stake.
-- Malacca state chief minister Mohd Zin Abdul Ghani remains in a coma after suffering a stroke on Sunday.

-- Mahathir urges the local media to be fairer to the government in its reporting, saying he was disappointed with prominence given to a court case involving a leader of the opposition Democratic Action Party.
-- Amsteel Securities has signed a memorandum of understanding to buy a substantial stake in Thai stockbroker First Asia Securities.
-- Maju Holdings is buying a substantial stake in appliance maker Berjaya Singer, said a source close to the company.
